chapter: Buck's Legion band and later gigs
title: Current playing partners, Club Plantation band and Al Domey
summary: Playing with Dominic Barocco, Lloyd Chapman and Nick Beninati; recalls the Club Plantation band and drummer Al.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then, I had been also playing with old Dominic Barocco. He's still playing the banjo and then there's this old violin player. He's a little bit of a guitar player. He's a little bit of a guitar player. His name is Lloyd Chapman. He has an amplifier on his violin. He knows all the old tunes from way back then. His wife was a real fine piano player. She died. And, uh, I had, so I played with them about three weeks ago. It was the weather. I also played with Nick Beninati too. He's a fondle of the trumpet man. He and his guitar man is, uh, who's over at Club Plantation?
Was he with, did he play with Nick? Henry Wilde. Yeah, yeah.
Henry Wilde, he plays fine guitar.
I know his brother Bill too. He's a good bass player. Yeah, he's fine. Well, that Club Plantation must have been a good band.
Oh, that was a good band. Oh, that was a good band. That was with, you know, Raymond Boyk and Charlie DuPont. The piano man was, let's see. I could see him right in front of me.
Was that before they had Chavez or after? No, it was, yeah, it was Julius Chavez, that's right. Oh, he was the one. Yeah.

The Melon Pickles. Yeah, the Melon Pickles. That's the band. And the drum? I used to listen to him every night over there. And the drum was pitch, you know? That was Al Domey? Yeah. Yeah. Al, well, is anything? The next time you see Al, ask him about Fazola. Yeah. And when he sees me, he says, the time I see you, I think of Fazola. Because we were always together, you know? Yeah. And he remembered that. Well, he also played at the Legion a couple of times with us. You know, Substituted? Mm-hmm. Boy, he plays a fine drums. And I played with the Marlis S. Cadillac a little bit. Antony's on Espinade and Galvis. Yeah, I know that joint.
